name: chain
spec:
type: chain
steps:
  - name: a
    run: echo a
  - name: b
    run: echo b
  - name: c
    run: echo c

name: chain with a parallel group
spec:
type: chain
steps:
  - name: a
    run: echo a
  - - name: b1
      run: echo b1
    - name: b2
      run: echo b2
  - name: c
    run: echo c

name: chain with ids
spec:
type: chain
steps:
  - id: first
    name: a
    run: echo a
  - id: second
    name: b
    run: echo b
  - name: c
    run: echo c

name: graph
spec:
type: graph
steps:
  - name: a
    run: echo a
  - name: b
    run: echo b
  - name: c
    depends: [a, b]
    run: echo c

name: graph with ids
spec:
type: graph
steps:
  - id: first
    name: a
    run: echo a
  - id: second
    name: b
    depends: [first]
    run: echo b
  - name: c
    depends: [second]
    run: echo c

name: graph with an output reference braced
spec:
type: graph
steps:
  - id: a
    name: a
    run: echo x
  - id: b
    name: b
    run: echo "${steps.a.outputs.x}"

name: graph with an output reference padded
spec:
type: graph
steps:
  - id: a
    name: a
    run: echo x
  - id: b
    name: b
    run: echo "${ steps.a.outputs.x }"

name: graph with an output reference unbraced
spec:
type: graph
steps:
  - id: a
    name: a
    run: echo x
  - id: b
    name: b
    run: echo $steps.a.outputs.x
